6a70da97a4bf6cded4fdaf53: Boots is thrilled to hear about the riddle contest today at the Tall Mountain. Who can solve the silliest riddle?
Uh oh! A big storm cloud is coming. Dora and Boots have to warn all their friends in the forest to get home fast so the big storm cloud doesn't rain on them and get them wet.

Boots can't wait for a super-duper toy fire truck that's coming in the mail. But when the package arrives, the box is empty! Seems the toy fell out and is now sitting far away on top of Snowy Mountain.

The stick, the stick, the magic stick! Dora and Boots find a magic stick, and according to the wise old tree frog, it's up to our two young heroes to go to the top of the highest hill to make the stick do its magic trick.

¡Falta algo! Something's missing! Dora and Boots meet a wizard, El Encantador, who's missing his magic wand! Dora and Boots set off on an educational adventure to find El Encantador's wand so he can do his magic.
Squeaky, squeaky! What's that sound? It's Squeaky, Boots' adorably squeezable new bath toy. But when Boots loses Squeaky, we all have to head to the Gooey Geyser to get him back.
Meet Rojo, the newest, shiniest red fire truck. Rojo invites our heroes along as he goes on his very first rescue mission—to help a kitten who's stuck in a tree.

Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?  The Map! But today the Map gets mistaken for a stick by a goofy bird. The bird flies Map all the way to his nest on top of Tallest Mountain.
It's Mother's Day, and Dora wants to help Papi bake Mamá a special cake. But three key ingredients are missing: bananas, nuts, and chocolate.
Go, go, go, Golden Explorers! Dora and her friends have formed a soccer team and are playing the big dinosaurs. Can Dora kick the ball into the net and score a goal?
¡Feliz Navidad! It's Christmas Eve, and Dora and Boots are going all the way to the North Pole to deliver a present to Santa.
Achoo, achoo! What's that sound? Benny the Bull has the sneezes. It's Doctor Dora to the rescue as she sets off for Benny's barn for a house call.

Yee haw! Cowgirl Dora and Cowboy Boots are riding through the Wild West on Pinto, the Pony Express. They have to deliver a special package of cowboy cookies to Benny the Bull. But they'll have to be on the lookout for Swiper.

Dora and Boots meet León, a friendly lion who wants to join the circus. They pedal on a unicycle, tightrope walk, and skate their way to the Big Top so León can become a circus lion and do all his tricks.
Step right up and join the fiesta! Dora and Boots are trying to win the grand prize—the Big Piñata! They need to collect 10 yellow tickets by playing carnival games and rides.
Nothing can stop Dora and Boots; they will not fail! Their job is to deliver the mail! Dora and Boots are mail carriers, and they need to deliver all the letters, even one to Swiper the Fox!

Map finds a red cape and becomes a superhero for the day. He can jump, he can fly, he can blow clouds away with a single, super breath! He's Super Map! When Dora's mommy calls her home, Dora and Boots need to get home fast.
Dora has tried and tried, but she's never been able to climb all the way across the monkey bars. Dora and Boots set off for Play Park so Dora can give it another try.
C'mon and join the musical parade! Dora and Boots are leading a parade over the Piano Bridge and through the Swinging Gate to free the instruments that were locked up by the evil Señor Shhh!
Dora and her friends are super good at hiding, especially Señor Tucán when he hides in the Rain Forest. If we can find all 8 friends, Señor Tucán promises to introduce us to his new baby toucans.

Finding the animals—that's a good trick! If you see an animal, aim and say, "Click!" Dora the photographer and her assistant, Boots, set off with a new camera to take pictures of wild animals for a photo contest.
Dora and Boots are on the hunt for cascarones—special eggs with confetti and prizes inside.

Dora and Boots are Super Spies on a top-secret mission: they have to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes. Spy gadgets—everything from rocket sneakers to a Swiper detector—will help them find their way.
Boots is visiting Dora's classroom when they notice that the school pet, a cute and cuddly hamster named Mimo, is missing from his cage. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to rescue him!
"Happy Birthday to you," plays the Birthday Balloon as it floats by high in the sky. There's going to be a birthday party—but whose birthday is it?

When Dora and Boots color in a picture of Mami Duck and her eggs, their coloring book magically comes to life, and the eggs start to hatch. Suddenly, the wind blows one of Mami Duck's eggs away. Oh no!
Mary had a Little Lamb, but now Little Lamb is lost.  Dora and Boots jump into a big book of Nursery Rhymes to bring Little Lamb back to her best friend, Mary.

Calling all trucks!  Boots sure loves trucks.  When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue.  Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.
What are we going to do?  Cockledoodledoo!  Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun.  Along the way we practice making lots of noise.
Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers, and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.
Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

Índia: Uma Jornada Pelo Selvagem: Gibbon crescendo

Os Gibbons Hoolock  são verdadeiros especialistas da selva indiana. Vivendo em grupos familiares unidos, os jovens devem passar até 9 anos aprendendo todas as habilidades necessárias para sobreviver sozinhos.
Índia: Uma Jornada Pelo Selvagem: Terra do Rinoceronte Secreto

As pastagens do Nordeste da Índia são um dos habitats mais férteis do planeta. Centenas de espécies de grama alta florescem aqui, permitindo que uma das criaturas mais icônicas da Índia prospere, o Grande Rinoceronte de Um chifre.
Índia: Uma Jornada Pelo Selvagem: Garanhões selvagens do Himalaia
O planalto de Ladakh, no noroeste da Índia, é uma terra de extremos. O ar está rarefeito e a paisagem montanhosa traiçoeira; os invernos são congelantes, enquanto os verões são extremamente quentes.
Índia: Uma Jornada Pelo Selvagem: O dilema de um Urso-preguiça

Em uma terra de calor escaldante de verão e tempestades tropicais, a vida de todos os que vivem nas planícies do sul da Índia é difícil. Mas este ano está mais difícil do que nunca, pois as chuvas das monções demoram a chegar.

Esta é uma das maiores migrações da natureza: a migração de gnus. Por pouco mais de 3 meses, Jean Du Plessis os acompanha desde a travessia do rio Mara até o local de nascimento em massa, onde milhões de animais estão em movimento inconstante.
O guia de safári Jean Du Plessis está no Serengeti testemunhando o maior nascimento em massa do planeta, onde a migração do gnu é interrompida anualmente.
Monte Kilimanjaro é o pico independente mais alto da África e tem as zonas mais climáticas de qualquer lugar do planeta.

Monte Kilimanjaro é o pico independente mais alto da África e tem as zonas mais climáticas de qualquer lugar do planeta. Jean Du Plessis tem guiado tours pelo Serengeti por vinte anos, mas agora ele faz sua primeira escalada até o pico.
Conheça o elefante Tafika enquanto faz uma grande escolha em seu treinamento.

O especialista em vida selvagem e guia de safári Jean Du Plessis viaja para o Parque Nacional das Montanhas Mahale na esperança de passar um tempo com os chimpanzés selvagens que vivem nas florestas neste canto remoto e protegido da Tanzânia.
Isolada e protegida, longe da agitação do rio Luangwa da Zâmbia, a lagoa Kasikizi é o lar de uma pequena comunidade de vida selvagem diversificada.

A Grande Curva tem mais de 2 milhas de comprimento, um dos maiores meandros ao longo do Rio Luangwa.É um local movimentado-lar de um grupo de hipopótamos que se deleitam em suas piscinas profundas, um importante ponto de passagem para elefantes.
Abarrotada de vida selvagem, uma pastagem fica no coração do Vale Luangwa, na Zâmbia, conhecida pelos habitantes locais como "A Planície de Ébano".

No meio da região de Ibitipoca, em Minas Gerais, uma gruta que era usada como refúgio dos escravos é visitada por Aruay e Anderson, que descobrem ricas informações sobre as plantas e animais da região.

Em Minas Gerais, Mayra, Aruay e Anderson visitam a Lagoa do Sumidoro, encontrando toda a riqueza da natureza de Minas Gerais e observam as pinturas rupestres de uma das áreas mais antigas habitada pelos homens das Américas.

Les Kangoo acceptent de participer à un extraordinaire marathon de basket. Ils devront rencontrer à la suite plusieurs équipes dont les Pirates, les Manhattan et les Petits Hommes de Westland. Le gain est de 10 millions de dollars Westlandais.

Alors que les Kangoo doivent disputer un match à l'autre bout du monde, Samy s'aperçoit avec angoisse que Tiffanie a disparu. Les Kangoo, très  inquiets, décident de passer à l'action et de partir à la recherche de la jeune fille.

Les Kangoo sont appelés au secours par les autorités du Mysialand. Une femme et son bébé se trouvent en grand danger au milieu d'un pont menaçant de s'écrouler. Les Kangoo décident de plonger, puis de s'encorder et d'escalader le pilier central.

Pour devenir la reine du monde, Vipéra a une idée diabolique: doubler, voire tripler la vitesse du vent ! Dans un ultimatum posé au Président Mc Connor, elle exige la démission de tous les dirigeants de la planète.

La reine du Misyaland jette son dévolu sur Nelson qu'elle décide d'épouser. Totalement grisé, celui-ci snobe ses amis en se prenant pour un vrai prince. Les Kangoo, Samy et Tiffanie sont bien décidés à empêcher ce mariage stupide.

Le comportement de Jimmy Mc Connor est bien étrange: le Président multiplie les impôts, fait des discours incompréhensibles à la TV, etc. Flairant un mystère, les Kangoo se rendent, de nuit, à la Maison Rose et apprennent la vérité.

Paren har 25 000 dollar i prispotten efter att ha röstat bort ett lögnarpar i första Sanningsceremonin. Misstankarna frodas i gruppen och utredningen intensifieras. En hemlig pakt bildas, men kommer den att lyckas?

De nya paren gör sig hemmastadda och börjar röra om. En utmaning under Toris ledning blottar sprickor i bakgrundshistorierna, och misstankar väcks. Men för ett par blir det för mycket, och de väljer att hoppa av.
En splittring uppstår mellan originalparen och nykomlingarna. Men trots alla undersökningar och misstankar har prispotten inte förändrats sen dag ett, och frustrationen tilltar.

Villan håller andan när ett pars försök att reparera relationen slutar i hjärtesorg. Parens kompatibilitet ifrågasätts på reflektionsceremonin, och vissa par funderar över sin framtid.
Charlotte får nyheter i sociala medier som ger smärtsamma minnen, men hon försöker fokusera på framtiden - sin nya kärlek Josh, och att lappa ihop relationen med sin bästis Melissa.
Tjejerna på turné! Charlotte åker på jobbresa till Australien med Melissa. Hon känner att hon kan lita på Josh när hon är borta, men under en utekväll i Sydney begår hon ett hemskt misstag.

Väl på brittisk mark igen vill Charlotte lägga förra veckans fyllemisstag bakom sig, men kan Josh förlåta hennes snedsteg? Dessutom lägger hon stor möda på att ordna en episk 50-årsfest för sin pappa.
